Life & Character

GBENGA Adeboye,the man of God who never become one.

October 24, 2026 3 min read Latunde Akin

GBENGA Adeboye,the man of God who never become one.
Only people born before years 2000 can know him.
He was brought down by disobedience to divine instruction.
He was brought down by women!
His father who was a Deacon and his prophet told him never to marry the woman he married because the end is not going to be good for him.
He refused and went away to conduct the wedding without any of his parents and siblings.
God told him he is His servant that he should rededicate his life to the gospel. He kept postponing till the enemy cut his life short.
A reckless spender and giver. He lived his life making others happy but nothing could make him happy on the long run without obedience to God.
He enjoyed drinking alcoholic beers,sleeping out with friends and doing juju.
The first person witness account is on the interrnet so it's not a rumor please. You can search it.
He lived carelessly believing he has special powers from God and juju. He trusted people so much without controlling how he talked. And people around him can't trust him with any secret because he couldn't control his tongue anywhere.
Being a communicator,comedian and entertainer shouldn't mean we mustn't briddlle our tongue. Wherever necessary. Same tongue that is making money can as well mar things if we do not tame it.
He suffered intestinal perforations. After successful surgery and doctor's instruction not to give him any drink orally. His wife gave him tea and it necessitated second surgery which caused his demise.
Draw lessons from here
Gbenga disobeyed his parents instructions not to marry the second wife. He got married without them and the end wasn't good.
Who do you know you're disobeying now?
Please think deeply and be calm. What they see you don't see. So it's better you are patient.
What is God's instruction for your life now,but you are rejecting or sidelining it?
You love the world and enjoyment more than your CREATOR?
Please change now and obey God's purpose for your life before it's too late.
Gbenga Adeboye even at that disobedient state always prophesy and see open visions. God didn't withdraw those gifts from him. If he tells you your future believe it,that's how it is. But he never obeyed God's calling to totally dedicate himself to God's work.
The time he realised the need to do that,he wept bitterly on sick bed and left the scene with unfinished task of total dedication to God.
This is never to say anything negative but to let people know their needs to remember their God while it is day. Because the night cometh when no man can work.
Money,fame,pleasure are good but God must always comes first.
Are you living your life carelessly too?
May God have mercy on you today. In Jesus name. Amen
Your brother
Latunde Akin
